properties.natural_language: A transaction must not be forwarded to the Ethereum node unless the user has explicitly approved it via the authorization popup.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Prevents unauthorized transaction execution; ensures user consent for all value transfers and contract interactions.
properties.implementation_constraint: Authorization popup must be shown for every eth_sendTransaction request; no automatic approval mechanisms.

properties.natural_language: When a user rejects a transaction, it must not be sent to the node and a cancel error must be returned to the dapp.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Prevents dapp from bypassing user rejection; ensures user veto authority.
properties.implementation_constraint: User rejection must immediately terminate transaction flow without any further processing.

properties.natural_language: The authorization popup must display the complete transaction details (from, to, gas, gasPrice) before user decision.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Prevents parameter substitution attacks; user must see actual transaction parameters.
properties.implementation_constraint: Popup rendering must not omit or obfuscate any required transaction field.

properties.natural_language: Account unlock duration must not exceed 3 seconds when the personal API is exposed.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Limits attack window for exploiting unlocked accounts; prevents prolonged exposure of private key access.
properties.implementation_constraint: Unlock mechanism must auto-lock after exactly 3 seconds; no extension of unlock duration.

properties.natural_language: Only read-only RPC methods in the allowedMethods whitelist can be executed via the invisible iframe.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Prevents account unlocking or transaction signing via iframe; enforces read-only access.
properties.implementation_constraint: Whitelist must contain exactly 43 read-only methods; no dynamic additions allowed.

properties.natural_language: RPC methods requiring account unlocking must return a notAllowed error when called via iframe.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Prevents privilege escalation from read-only to write access via iframe channel.
properties.implementation_constraint: Whitelist check must occur before any method execution; no bypass mechanism.

properties.natural_language: Transaction requests with missing required fields (from, to, gas, gasPrice) must be rejected with a notValid error.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Prevents malformed transactions from reaching authorization popup; ensures all critical parameters are present.
properties.implementation_constraint: Validation must check for presence and non-null values of all required fields.

properties.natural_language: The eth_sign method must be explicitly prohibited and rejected before any processing.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Prevents signing of arbitrary data that could be replay-attacked; eth_sign is inherently unsafe.
properties.implementation_constraint: Method type check must occur before authorization popup is displayed.

properties.natural_language: Every valid eth_sendTransaction request that passes validation and receives user approval must eventually be forwarded to the Ethereum node.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Ensures user-approved transactions are not lost or blocked by the authorization system.
properties.implementation_constraint: No failure points between user approval and node submission except explicit user rejection.

properties.natural_language: Every whitelisted read-only RPC request via iframe must eventually return a result or error.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Prevents denial of service against dapps using read-only RPC; ensures responsiveness.
properties.implementation_constraint: RPC execution must have timeout mechanism to prevent indefinite blocking.

properties.natural_language: Transaction parameters displayed in the authorization popup must match the parameters actually sent to the node.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Prevents parameter substitution attacks where displayed params differ from sent params.
properties.implementation_constraint: No mutation of transaction parameters between popup display and node submission.

properties.natural_language: All error responses must include a matching request ID, null result, and properly classified error type.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Ensures dapp receives accurate error information; prevents error confusion attacks.
properties.implementation_constraint: Error formatting must preserve request ID correlation and use standardized error types.

properties.natural_language: Every begin_transaction() call must be paired with exactly one commit_transaction() or rollback_transaction() call.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Prevents snapshot stack corruption; ensures state consistency across transaction boundaries.
properties.implementation_constraint: Transaction lifecycle must enforce strict pairing; no orphaned snapshots allowed.

properties.natural_language: Nested transactions must be committed or rolled back in LIFO order (last-in-first-out).
properties.threat_model_mapping: Prevents out-of-order snapshot manipulation; maintains stack discipline for nested calls.
properties.implementation_constraint: Snapshot stack must enforce LIFO semantics; no arbitrary snapshot popping.

properties.natural_language: Rollback must restore main_trie and storage_tries to the exact state captured in the snapshot.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Ensures atomicity of failed transactions; prevents partial state changes from persisting.
properties.implementation_constraint: Snapshot must capture complete state; rollback must not have partial restoration.

properties.natural_language: The created_accounts set must only be cleared when the outermost transaction is committed.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Ensures created_accounts tracking persists across nested call frames until transaction completes.
properties.implementation_constraint: created_accounts clearing must only occur at outermost commit.

properties.natural_language: Empty accounts (nonce=0, code empty, balance=0) must be automatically destroyed after modification.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Prevents accumulation of empty account entries; maintains state trie efficiency.
properties.implementation_constraint: modify_state must automatically invoke empty check; no manual destruction required.

properties.natural_language: When an account is destroyed, its associated storage trie must also be destroyed.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Prevents storage leaks; ensures complete account cleanup on SELFDESTRUCT or empty account removal.
properties.implementation_constraint: Account destruction must atomically destroy both account entry and storage trie.

properties.natural_language: Writing U256(0) to a storage key must delete the key from the trie.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Ensures storage slot deletion; prevents trie bloat from zero-value entries.
properties.implementation_constraint: set_storage must explicitly delete keys when value is U256(0).

properties.natural_language: get_storage_original must always read from the first snapshot in the stack for accurate gas calculation.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Ensures correct SSTORE gas calculation based on pre-transaction state; prevents gas cost manipulation.
properties.implementation_constraint: get_storage_original must never read from current state; always use first snapshot.

properties.natural_language: Transient storage must be completely cleared when a transaction completes (no persistence across transactions).
properties.threat_model_mapping: Prevents cross-transaction data leakage via transient storage; ensures EIP-1153 semantics.
properties.implementation_constraint: Transaction completion must clear entire transient storage trie.

properties.natural_language: Rollback of nested calls must restore transient storage to the snapshot state.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Ensures transient storage atomicity within transaction; prevents partial updates on revert.
properties.implementation_constraint: Transient snapshots must be part of call frame snapshot mechanism.

properties.natural_language: move_ether must assert that sender balance is greater than or equal to transfer amount before debiting.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Prevents negative balances; ensures conservation of ether during transfers.
properties.implementation_constraint: Balance check must occur before any state mutation; must use assertion to halt on failure.

properties.natural_language: The sum of sender debit and recipient credit in move_ether must equal the transfer amount (balance conservation).
properties.threat_model_mapping: Ensures ether is neither created nor destroyed during transfers; maintains total supply invariant.
properties.implementation_constraint: Debit and credit must be atomic; no intermediate state where sum is non-zero.

properties.natural_language: G1 point coordinates must be less than the ALT_BN128 field modulus to be considered valid.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Prevents invalid field arithmetic; ensures points are within the finite field.
properties.implementation_constraint: Field validation must occur before any curve operations.

properties.natural_language: Non-zero points must satisfy the ALT_BN128 curve equation y^2 = x^3 + 3 to be considered on the curve.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Prevents invalid curve attacks; ensures cryptographic operations are performed on valid curve points.
properties.implementation_constraint: On-curve check must be performed for all non-infinity points.

properties.natural_language: Input (0,0) must be treated as the point at infinity and considered valid without curve checking.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Ensures correct handling of identity element; prevents rejection of valid infinity point.
properties.implementation_constraint: Infinity check must occur before curve equation validation.

properties.natural_language: Pairing input length must be a multiple of 192 bytes (128-byte G2 + 64-byte G1 per pair).
properties.threat_model_mapping: Prevents malformed input from causing undefined behavior; ensures correct pair parsing.
properties.implementation_constraint: Length check must occur before any input parsing.

properties.natural_language: Pairing points must pass subgroup order validation (point * curve_order != infinity).
properties.threat_model_mapping: Prevents small subgroup attacks; ensures points are in the correct cryptographic subgroup.
properties.implementation_constraint: Subgroup check must multiply by curve order and verify result is infinity.

properties.natural_language: ALT_BN128 addition must charge exactly 150 gas regardless of input values.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Prevents DoS via underpriced operations; ensures consistent gas costs.
properties.implementation_constraint: Gas charge must be constant 150; no dynamic pricing.

properties.natural_language: Pairing gas cost must be calculated as 34000 * k + 45000 where k is the number of pairs.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Prevents DoS via excessive pairing pairs; gas cost scales linearly with computational work.
properties.implementation_constraint: Gas calculation must use exact formula; no approximations.

properties.natural_language: BLS12-381 G1 addition input must be exactly 256 bytes (two 128-byte G1 points).
properties.threat_model_mapping: Prevents buffer overruns and parsing errors; ensures correct input format.
properties.implementation_constraint: Length check must occur before any input parsing.

properties.natural_language: G1 MSM input length must be greater than 0 and divisible by 160 bytes (128-byte point + 32-byte scalar).
properties.threat_model_mapping: Prevents empty MSM operations and misaligned pair parsing.
properties.implementation_constraint: Validation must reject zero-length inputs and enforce 160-byte alignment.

properties.natural_language: BLS12-381 G2 addition input must be exactly 512 bytes (two 256-byte G2 points).
properties.threat_model_mapping: Ensures G2 operations receive correctly sized inputs.
properties.implementation_constraint: Length validation for G2 must enforce 512-byte requirement.

properties.natural_language: Pairing input length must be divisible by 384 bytes (128-byte G1 + 256-byte G2 per pair).
properties.threat_model_mapping: Prevents malformed pairing inputs; ensures correct pair extraction.
properties.implementation_constraint: Pairing length check must enforce 384-byte multiple constraint.

properties.natural_language: BLS12-381 pairing points must pass subgroup membership check (point * curve_order = infinity).
properties.threat_model_mapping: Prevents small subgroup attacks on BLS12-381 pairing; ensures cryptographic soundness.
properties.implementation_constraint: Subgroup check must multiply each point by curve order and verify infinity result.

properties.natural_language: Pairing result must return 0x01 (success) if and only if the accumulated pairing product equals FQ12.one().
properties.threat_model_mapping: Ensures correct pairing verification for zkSNARK and signature validation.
properties.implementation_constraint: Pairing comparison must use exact FQ12 equality check.

properties.natural_language: BLS12-381 G1 addition must charge exactly 500 gas (GAS_BLS_G1_ADD).
properties.threat_model_mapping: Prevents DoS via underpriced G1 operations.
properties.implementation_constraint: Gas charge must be constant 500 for G1 addition.

properties.natural_language: MSM gas cost must apply discount based on pair count k, using table lookup for k≤128 or max discount for k>128.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Ensures MSM gas scales sub-linearly to encourage batch operations; prevents DoS.
properties.implementation_constraint: Discount lookup must use exact table values; no interpolation.

properties.natural_language: Pairing gas must be calculated as 32600 * k + 37700 where k is the number of pairing pairs.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Prevents DoS via excessive pairing pairs; costs scale with computational work.
properties.implementation_constraint: Gas calculation must use exact formula with no approximations.

properties.natural_language: All BLS12-381 field elements must be less than the BLS12-381 field modulus.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Prevents invalid field arithmetic; ensures operations stay within the finite field.
properties.implementation_constraint: Field validation must occur before any curve operations.

properties.natural_language: Decoded points must satisfy the BLS12-381 curve equation (implicit in bytes_to_g1/g2).
properties.threat_model_mapping: Prevents invalid curve attacks; ensures all points lie on BLS12-381 curve.
properties.implementation_constraint: Curve equation check must be part of point decoding.

properties.natural_language: Transactions with nonce >= 2^64-1 must be rejected before any processing.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Prevents nonce overflow; enforces retroactive nonce limit from genesis.
properties.implementation_constraint: Nonce limit check must occur during transaction validation; must reject at limit, not after.

properties.natural_language: Account nonce increments must not overflow the 2^64-1 limit.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Prevents account from reaching unusable state; once nonce hits max, account cannot send more transactions.
properties.implementation_constraint: Nonce increment must check for overflow; reaching 2^64-1 locks account permanently.

properties.natural_language: CREATE/CREATE2 must return 0 without executing initcode when sender nonce equals 2^64-1.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Prevents gas cost for initcode when creation will fail; fails gracefully without exception.
properties.implementation_constraint: CREATE nonce check must occur before initcode execution; must not deduct initcode gas.

properties.natural_language: EIP-2384 difficulty bomb delay must activate at exactly block 9,200,000 on mainnet.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Ensures consensus on fork activation; prevents chain splits from disagreement on activation block.
properties.implementation_constraint: Fork activation must be deterministic based solely on block number.

properties.natural_language: Difficulty calculation must use the fake block number (with offset) after Muir Glacier activation.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Ensures difficulty bomb is delayed as intended; prevents premature ice age.
properties.implementation_constraint: Difficulty calculation must apply EIP-2384 offset consistently across all nodes.

properties.natural_language: Fork activation block must be network-specific: mainnet at 9,200,000, Ropsten at 7,117,117, PoA chains never.
properties.formal_logic: ∀block ∈ Blocks: (network = mainnet ∧ block.number ≥ 9200000) ∨ (network = ropsten ∧ block.number ≥ 7117117) → (fork_active = true)
properties.threat_model_mapping: Prevents cross-network fork confusion; ensures each network follows its own activation schedule.
properties.implementation_constraint: Network identification must be based on chain ID; activation logic must be network-aware.

properties.natural_language: The retroactively activated nonce limit of 2^64-1 must be enforced for all transactions.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Enforces EIP-2681 retroactively; prevents nonce overflow attacks.
properties.implementation_constraint: Nonce limit must apply to all historical and future blocks.

properties.natural_language: Transactions from senders with deployed code (contract accounts) must be rejected (EIP-3607).
properties.threat_model_mapping: Prevents contracts from being transaction origins; closes signature forgery attack vector.
properties.implementation_constraint: Sender code check must occur during transaction validation before execution.

properties.natural_language: Transaction gas limit must not exceed 2^63-1 (EIP-4803 retroactive limit).
properties.threat_model_mapping: Prevents integer overflow in gas accounting; enforces reasonable gas limits.
properties.implementation_constraint: Gas limit check must be enforced retroactively from genesis.

properties.natural_language: CREATE/CREATE2 must revert if the target address already has non-empty storage (EIP-7610).
properties.threat_model_mapping: Prevents storage collision attacks; ensures CREATE2 address uniqueness guarantees.
properties.implementation_constraint: Storage collision check must occur before initcode execution.

properties.natural_language: EXTCODEADDRESS must halt with exception if the target address has non-zero high 12 bytes.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Prevents invalid address formats from causing undefined behavior.
properties.implementation_constraint: Address validation must check high 12 bytes before any state access.

properties.natural_language: EXTCODEADDRESS must return the delegation target if code starts with 0xef0100, otherwise return the original address.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Ensures correct delegation resolution; critical for sponsorship contract security.
properties.implementation_constraint: Delegation check must parse EIP-7702 prefix correctly; must not resolve recursively.

properties.natural_language: EXTCODEADDRESS must charge 100 gas for warm access and 2,600 gas for cold access.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Prevents DoS via excessive cold accesses; incentivizes access locality.
properties.implementation_constraint: Warm/cold status must be based on accessed_addresses set; cold access must warm only target, not delegation target.

properties.natural_language: Only the target_address must be added to accessed_addresses, not the delegation target.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Ensures correct gas accounting for subsequent operations on delegation target.
properties.implementation_constraint: Warming logic must only add the queried address, not the resolved delegation target.

properties.natural_language: Sponsorship contracts must verify delegation target against whitelist before proceeding.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Prevents unauthorized delegation targets from receiving sponsorship; protects sponsorship budgets.
properties.implementation_constraint: Whitelist check must occur before any value transfer or state change.

properties.natural_language: BLAKE2F input must be exactly 213 bytes or execution must fail with InvalidParameter.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Prevents buffer overruns and parsing errors; ensures correct parameter extraction.
properties.implementation_constraint: Length validation must occur before any input parsing.

properties.natural_language: The final block flag (byte 212) must be either 0 or 1, otherwise execution must fail.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Prevents undefined behavior in compression function; ensures valid flag values.
properties.implementation_constraint: Final flag validation must check for exact values 0 or 1.

properties.natural_language: BLAKE2F gas cost must be calculated as rounds * GAS_BLAKE2_PER_ROUND before execution.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Prevents DoS via excessive compression rounds; gas cost scales linearly with computational work.
properties.implementation_constraint: Gas calculation must occur before compression execution; must use exact formula.

properties.natural_language: If insufficient gas is available, BLAKE2F must fail with OutOfGasError before execution.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Prevents execution with insufficient gas; ensures gas accounting integrity.
properties.implementation_constraint: Gas check must occur before any compression rounds are executed.

properties.natural_language: All requests generated during transaction execution must be appended to the block's request list.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Ensures all EL requests reach CL; prevents request loss or omission.
properties.implementation_constraint: Request accumulation must be part of block execution; no requests can be dropped.

properties.natural_language: The requests_hash in the block header must be SHA256(concatenated hashes of sorted non-empty requests).
properties.threat_model_mapping: Provides integrity commitment for EL-to-CL requests; prevents request forgery by validators.
properties.implementation_constraint: Hash computation must follow exact ordering (type ascending) and filtering (exclude empty); must use SHA256.

properties.natural_language: Requests with empty request_data must be excluded from the requests_hash calculation.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Prevents hash pollution from empty requests; ensures only meaningful requests are committed.
properties.implementation_constraint: Empty data filter must be applied before hashing.

properties.natural_language: Blocks with no requests must have requests_hash equal to SHA256('') (empty string hash).
properties.threat_model_mapping: Ensures consistent hash representation for empty request lists; prevents ambiguity.
properties.implementation_constraint: Empty block case must explicitly set requests_hash to SHA256('').

properties.natural_language: Consensus layer must independently validate all request contents before processing.
properties.threat_model_mapping: CL cannot trust EL request contents; must validate independently to prevent malicious requests.
properties.implementation_constraint: CL validation must occur before any state changes; validation rules are request-type-specific.

properties.natural_language: All validated requests must eventually be processed by the consensus layer.
properties.threat_model_mapping: Ensures validated requests are not lost; CL must eventually process all valid requests.
properties.implementation_constraint: CL processing must handle all requests in the list; no selective processing allowed.
